operations.name: send-sms
operations.summary: Send an SMS (also used for template sends)

fields.name: body
fields.description: Message body (standard 90 bytes, up to 255 characters, EUC-KR)

fields.name: requestDate
fields.description: Scheduled time (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm), up to 60 days ahead

fields.name: recipientList
fields.description: Recipients (up to 1,000): recipientNo, countryCode, internationalRecipientNo, templateParameter, recipientGroupingKey

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Sender identifier, e.g. admin or system

fields.name: originCode
fields.description: Identification code (9-digit registration number of a special value-added carrier)

fields.name: useConversion
fields.description: Collect the conversion rate (default false; not with requestDate)
